newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-H.Norman says could sell F&P in NZ.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-H.Norman says could sell F&P in NZ.

text.p: Australian retailer, Harvey Norman Holdings Ltd said it was likely to distribute the home appliance products of New Zealand whitegoods maker Fisher and Paykel Ltd (F&P) when it opens stores in New Zealand next year.
Asked if Harvey Norman would sell F&P products, the company's chairman, Gerry Harvey said: "Yeah... well that decision hasn't been made but probably."
Harvey said the company plans to open three stores in Auckland next year.
"Assuming they go OK, then we'll open another 15 over the next five years over there," Harvey said.
Harvey Norman is a big F&P customer in Australia.
In June, F&P said it would withdraw franchised whiteware products from appliance retailer Noel Leeming if Leeming's proposed merger with unlisted Bond and Bond went ahead.
Bond and Bond is a unit of Murray International Holdings Ltd.

"New Zealand is going very well at the moment. In Auckland retailing is so bad I can't begin to tell you. It's worse than the worst country town you have ever been in to," Harvey Norman director Katie Page told the annual meeting.
